releaseTitle: v1.4.3 — Windows 11 Start Menu Fix for Redirected Domain Profiles, One-Click Start Menu Repair Tool, and Clean Generic Server Placeholders
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.4.3 fixes Windows 11 Start Menu visibility on domain workstations using Folder Redirection by installing a local All-Users Start Menu shortcut and registering Windows App Paths, adds a one-click 'Add / Repair Windows Start Menu Shortcut' option under Help, and replaces internal server example strings in documentation and update dialogs with clean generic placeholders.
features: Windows 11 Start Menu Visibility Fix for Redirected Profiles: On Windows 11 PCs where Start Menu Folder Redirection points to a UNC network share, Windows ignores network-hosted shortcuts. Setup now cleans duplicate subfolder shortcuts, registers HKCU App Paths, and places a local shortcut in ProgramData Start Menu so Ohr HaKsav appears immediately in Start Menu → All Apps and Start Search.

One-Click 'Add / Repair Windows Start Menu Shortcut' (Help Menu): Already-installed users updating via the fast ~49 MB delta patch can click Help → Add / Repair Windows Start Menu Shortcut to register Ohr HaKsav in the Windows 11 Start Menu immediately without re-running Setup.
Sanitized Generic Server Examples: Replaced internal server placeholder strings in Update Settings, Help dialogs, README, and User Guide with clean generic examples (\\fileserver\Installs\OhrHaKsav).
Fast ~49 MB Delta Patch Ready (engineVersion 1.4): Existing v1.4.0–v1.4.2 installations automatically download only the slim ~49 MB SHA-256-verified patch.
